> Skeleton for a decision record. Copy it to
> `docs/decisions/<id>-<slug>.md`, fill every field (SPEC-1 sections 3
> and 8.4), and delete this note. A note in this blockquote form is
> invisible to the head-of-file and archive checks, so a copy left
> half-filled still fails for the right reason.

**Status: draft.**

## Question

One interrogative sentence (SPEC-1 section 8.3).

## Ruling

The answer, stated as a rule an agent can apply. Numbered constraints
where the ruling has parts.

## Why

The argument. What was rejected, and on what grounds. If the ruling rests
on an observation, say what was observed (SPEC-1 section 3, `grade`).

## Consequences

What this obliges, what it forecloses, and what work it creates.

## History

Added under SPEC-1 section 8.1. Until then this heading can be deleted.
